items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: You know they had another band used to play in the city here. Newman's band.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you just a few more, one or two more things. We spoke about Buddy Petit and his style, Chris Kelly and his style. What about Kid René? We didn't say too much about his style.
Well, what I know about René, René, he had a different style of playing music. You know they had another band used to play in the city here. Newman's band.
